Source from LSIFPF12 (lines 350-399 of 1636, 50 lines retrieved):

```abap
  CASE P_CONT_ATTR-TYPE.
    WHEN RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-ROOT.        "Universalcontainer
                                       "nothing to do

    WHEN RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-DYNPRO.      "Universalcontainer
                                       "nothing to do

    WHEN RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-SCREEN.      "Universalcontainer
                                       "nothing to do

    WHEN RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-LOOP.        "Loop:
      " Position und Größe; Loopblock-Info
      P_CONT_ATTR-LINE   = 0.
      P_CONT_ATTR-COLUMN = 0.
      P_CONT_ATTR-LENGTH = 0.
      P_CONT_ATTR-HEIGHT = 0.
*     kleinstmögliches Quadrat bestimmen, das alle Loop-Felder umfaßt.
*     LOOP-Felder können entweder direkt dem Loop-Container zugeordnet
*     sein oder indirekt einem Auswahlknopfcontainer zugeordnet sein,
*     der in einem LOOP steckt.
*     Deshalb die in Frage kommenden Container sammeln:
*     a) direkter Loop-Container
      REFRESH S_CONT_LIST.
      S_CONT_LIST-NAME = P_CONT_ATTR-NAME.
      S_CONT_LIST-TYPE = P_CONT_ATTR-TYPE.
      APPEND S_CONT_LIST.
*     b) Auswahlknopfcontainer zu diesem Loop
      LOOP AT P_DYNP_CONTAINERS.
*        S_CONT_A = P_DYNP_CONTAINERS-CONT.
        S_CONT_A = P_DYNP_CONTAINERS.
        CHECK S_CONT_A-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-RADIOGROUP.
        CHECK S_CONT_A-ELEMENT_OF = P_CONT_ATTR-NAME.
        S_CONT_LIST-NAME = S_CONT_A-NAME.
        S_CONT_LIST-TYPE = S_CONT_A-TYPE.
        APPEND S_CONT_LIST.
      ENDLOOP.
*     Nun sind die in Frage kommenden Container gesammelt.
*     Die in ihnen enthaltenen Felder können ausgewertet werden.
      LOOP AT P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND.
        OK = ' '.
        LOOP AT S_CONT_LIST
             WHERE NAME = P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-CONT_NAME
             AND   TYPE = P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-CONT_TYPE.
          OK = 'X'.
          EXIT.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF OK = ' '.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        FIELD_INT = P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-FIELD.
```
